title: Jensen Huang's Own Words During His 11 Days Away #Shorts
description:
Jensen Huang's own words during his 11 days away from Nvidia: he admitted 'serious mistakes' in his personal life, said he would cooperate with the board's investigation, agreed to answer questions from Congress, and said he would be 'honoured' to return. Six days later, on 23 Nov, the board reinstated him.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):

- AP via PBS NewsHour: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/nvidia-board-unanimously-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-and-chairman
